persos.desc: landlord in his 60s, teal-and-copper kaftan, grey beard, glasses, holding ONE single folder of papers
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, holding the folder up, triumphant

persos.desc: man in his 30s, jade-and-indigo polo shirt, short dreadlocks, arms crossed, calm smile
persos.pose: standing on the right in front of his door, arms crossed, relaxed

dialogue: Je vends ma cour ! Tout le monde dehors dans un mois dêh !
Ya fohi, Tonton. C'est moi l'acheteur-là.
Toi-là ? Avec quel argent ?!
Trois ans de loyer que j'ai pas payés dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The landlord announces it triumphantly, raising the folder. The tenant answers calmly, arms crossed. The landlord frowns and leans forward, suspicious. The tenant answers with a big calm smile, his face clearly visible.
chute: The landlord freezes, the folder slowly dropping to his side, his mouth hanging open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the selling landlord's stunned face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE PROPRIÉTAIRE APRÈS CETTE RÉPONSE :
mecanisme: retournement : le mauvais payeur rachète la cour avec l'argent qu'il doit
